function: Joint device activity detection and channel estimation (JADCE) for grant-free access, posed as MMV sparse recovery of the beamspace channel at the LEO satellite (p. 5).
system: LEO satellite with 100-antenna UPA, 19 RF chains (hybrid); single-antenna ground devices; 4 passive reflecting IRS panels; 2 GHz carrier (p. 3, p. 11).
method: Deep unfolding: MMV OAMPNet with learnable step sizes, plus data-driven SMNet denoiser (DOAMPNet); supervised layer-by-layer training on NMSE loss, 7 layers (p. 6, p. 9, p. 11).
data_channel: Own simulated multipath beamspace channel (Rician 8 dB, up to 6 paths, random Doppler and delay); 20,000 training and 2,000 test samples (p. 11).
test_conditions: Training at SNR 12-18 dB; tests sweep SNR, pilots (40-80), GDs (100-500) and activity (0.05-0.15); no unseen scenario or retraining statement (p. 11-13).
baselines: Non-learned: SWOMP, GMMV-AMP, MMV-OAMP. Learned: PDNN, LISTA, MMV-LAMP, parallel SMV-OAMPNet; variant with CDRN instead of SMNet (p. 11).
metrics: NMSE (channel estimation), activity error probability (AEP), percentage of correct detection improvement with IRS, pilot overhead reduction (p. 10, p. 13).
complexity: Orders O(N N_RF(P^3+P^2K)) for MMV OAMPNet and O(N(N_RF(P+P^2K)+c_n)) for DOAMPNet; computation time 1.847 s for DOAMPNet versus 0.347 s for LAMP (p. 13, p. 14).
q1_support: p. 10: "scenario of the LEO satellite communications recommended by the 3GPP" is cited only for the parameters of Table II; p. 3: "We adopt multi-path channel model to characterize the uplink" and p. 10: "channel gain follows" a complex Gaussian draw show an own simulator. Missing: a named 3GPP TR 38.811 or 38.901 channel model, QuaDRiGa, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "we train all the DL based network at SNRs between 12 dB and 18 dB", and the tests sweep SNR, pilots (Fig. 7), GDs (Fig. 8) and activity (Fig. 9); p. 10: "parameters can be fine-tuned through transfer learning" is only proposed, with no result. Missing: a model trained at one setting and tested at another.
q3_support: p. 11: non-learned "SWOMP, GMMV-AMP, MMV-OAMP"; learned "PDNN" and "including LISTA [53] and MMVLAMP [19]", compared on NMSE and AEP (Figs. 6-8), e.g. "DOAMPNet is improved by about 4 dB compared with LAMP".
q4_support: p. 13: "complexity of DOAMPNet is" O(N(N_RF(P+P^2K)+c_n)) and "the computational complexity of MMV OAMPNet is given by" O(N N_RF(P^3+P^2K)); p. 14, Table IV "AVERAGE COMPUTATION TIME OF VARIOUS ALGORITHMS": 0.347 s (LAMP) to 1.847 s (DOAMPNet).
q5_support: p. 10: "we provide numerical simulation results"; p. 11: "All deep learning networks are implemented via TensorFlow" with no code or data link, and Table II lists 20,000 training and 2,000 test samples from the own simulator. Missing: any code or data release, or a public channel dataset.
notes: Included as area 2: the learned function is channel estimation with activity detection, and the main metric is NMSE (p. 1 abstract: "normalized mean-square error improvement of about 4 dB"). Area 6 does not fit because the method does estimation, not resource, power or beam control. The IRS is passive and fixed during JADCE (p. 4), so ris is 1 but the RIS is not configured. q1 for the reviewer: 3GPP is named only for the scenario (p. 10), no channel model of TR 38.811 or 38.901 is cited. Tables I to IV were read as page images (pp. 8, 11, 13, 14).
